Published in *Conservation Letters*. [doi:10.1111/conl.13077](https://doi.org/10.1111/conl.13077)

Causal evidence from Japanese online marketplaces that trade bans under the Act on Conservation of Endangered Species can spill demand over into unregulated, threatened species.
